cause_quote: The diff wrapped `maybeRestartService` in `await forward(() =>` and added `for (const stop of admission.forward) { stop(); }`, so an interrupt cancelled native service checks while the readiness loop kept polling.
user_saw: After Ctrl-C or SIGTERM during update verification, the updater kept reporting `service=unknown` and `health=ready` even though the Gateway was running.
summary: The fix makes Gateway readiness polling honor update cancellation and sizes the candidate admission timeout from measured SQLite state within the step deadline.
reasoning: I classified the interrupted-update hang because it was the headline failure. The parent used the earlier signal-exit path, and #165863 introduced automatic recovery during verification while the readiness loop still observed only its explicit or deadline signal, so the new recovery path shipped with the hang. The same fix also addresses a separate timeout whose fixed 120-second default dates to the introduction of candidate admission in #155632.
